# Short #008 - Pan Am's First Moon Flights Club

## Title options (1 = recommended)
1. 93,000 People Booked a Flight to the Moon. With an Airline.
2. Pan Am Took Reservations for Flights to the Moon
3. The Airline That Sold Tickets to the Moon

## Description
Pan Am issued more than 93,000 free "First Moon Flights" club cards between 1968 and 1971, with the first flight expected around the year 2000. The airline stopped taking new names in 1971 and declared bankruptcy in 1991. Some of the cards are now in museum collections.

Visuals are AI-generated concept art, not photographs or historical footage.
